name: Sockdolager
quote: Do Doll hunters dream of electric sheep?

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Morning, Professor.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: I want to sunbathe on a field...

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: It's getting dark. Should we start a campfire and sing some songs?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Hmm... Still awake at this time of night, Professor?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: You know, I really like the name "Oasis". It evokes images of liveliness and vitality, such as sunrises and burgeoning saplings.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Do you like hunting, Professor? It may be a very ancient sport, but it's still very popular nowadays.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Hmm? Are you asleep? Hehe, you look just like a little lamb...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: We have pretty good weather and sunshine today. Shall we go for a hunt, Professor?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Huh...? Are you trying to poke dimples into my cheeks, Professor?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: This knife is very sharp, be careful you don't hurt yourself with it.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Well? Very sturdy, eh? They can walk for days and nights on end in the mountains.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: I'm standing sentry? Sure.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: What? You still found me? Looks like I haven't been masking my presence very well, hehe.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: My sense of smell has grown sharper.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I'll hunt down every single poacher!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Respect nature, respect life.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: My arrow is nocked and ready.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Let's hunt.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: You're not getting away this time!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Hmm, we've got a pretty good haul.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Hahaha, what an easy victory! Way to go, me!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Hmm... I missed...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
H-how unexpected. I'm surprised you'd choose me, hahaha...
Have you had your eyes on me ever since the day we met? Or maybe it was the opposite... In any case, we're now bound together.
From now on, I'll call you by your nickname! Oh, now that I think about it, you don't actually have a nickname yet, so... "Little Lamb," how's that?

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Ugh... There you are, Professor. Can you help me deal with the Dolls who are about to come? They said they would be coming to pay me a New Year call and give me some kind of red packet money, but I feel kind of awkward about it... Hey, why don't we run away together?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
Um... I hope you'll accept this terrible-looking chocolate, Professor...
I worked really hard on it, but I just couldn't get it right. The taste should be okay though... I think.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text:
Professor, I made these Tanabata puppets. Don't they look nice? This is me, and this is you.
Here, hang them on your door. That will lend Hikoboshi and Orihime some clothes and prevent weird things from entering the house at the same time.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text:
Wah! Professor, there are lots of weird things outside! Bow and arrows... Where are my bow and arrows? Here they are! I'm ready, Professor! Let's go hunt down those scary pumpkin monsters!
... Huh? Those are just Halloween robots for decoration?

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Look, Professor! I found a present sitting on my bedside table! There really is Santa Claus in the Oasis! And he knows I like playing the guitar! Santa is the best! Now I can sing for you every day!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text:
Happy Birthday, Professor! Hmm... I suppose it's better if I sing it, after all?
In any case, today is a special day for you. I hope I can celebrate your birthday with you every year from now on.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
I used to work as a ranger. To prevent poaching, hunts are all strictly regulated within conservation areas.
My job was to ensure that hunts were conducted on legal grounds and to protect conservation areas.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Phew, that was a hard day of work. Oh, Angela's story session is about to start, I'd better hurry.
What? Listening to stories isn't just for kids, you know? Don't be such a killjoy.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
First, like this... Then do this... Then...
Argh, I messed up again! Why can't I make a decent paper crane...?
This must be a difficult challenge! That's right, whoever can do it must be a genius!

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
The key to hunting is the ability to mask your presence. Once you have spotted your prey, you must quietly, stealthily... approach from behind, then slowly... slowly... BANG!!!
Hahahahaha! You got scared, didn't you!?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
It's time to show off my unique talent! Ta-daaa!
This guitar is a proud creation of mine. It can produce a very special sound. Well? Want me to play it for you?
If you want to hear it so badly, I'll give you a private concert after we leave Magrasea.

career:
HT-Alpha, a hunting support Doll developed by Svarog Heavy Industries, was primarily meant for overlooking and managing hunting practices within natural reserves, and was first put into use in 2055.

As one of Svarog's Environmental Protection Program's Dolls, Sockdolager was mainly responsible for assisting people with hunting legally and safely in the forests of Eastern Europe, as well as observing animal and plant life within the forests and taking protective measures against the effects of war or Collapse Fluid pollution.

Due to a hunting accident, Sockdolager's work stopped after a reversal of public opinion, and was entered into Project Neural Cloud by Svarog Heavy Industries.
infoStories:
The first impression Sockdolager leaves on people is not as ice-cold as the title of "professional hunter" would suggest. For the purpose of protecting the biosphere and endangered species, Sockdolager's neural systems are not only loaded with incredible amounts of hunting techniques, but also a rich depth of knowledge for the natural sciences. With this knowledge, Sockdolager can elegantly traverse within woodlands, accurately taking out designated prey without harming other life or damaging the local environment. For her, hunting is more the remembrance and inheritance of some rule of nature, not mere killing.

During her trial period, Sockdolager showed a great affinity for nature. With a body of steel, she found a quaint place for herself in the wealds—not even her designers could explain why when she entered those woods, she melded perfectly into that land of beasts, walking and flying.

As opposed to an instrument-filled research facility, Sockdolager seems much more inclined to her self-constructed cabin in the woodlands. Without work at hand, she would often serve as a groundskeeper, patrolling the forests, meeting her best friend on the way—the falcon often found nestled on her shoulder, "Hobbie". Afterwards, she requested a specially designed Animal Signal Reception Device, allowing her to communicate and cooperate with Hobbie better. The chirps and songs amongst the woods spurred up an interest of music in Sockdolager. You could often find her strolling amongst the trees, self-crafted guitar in hand, humming along to her own tunes.

"If some undiscovered civilization really existed within the depths of those woods, then Sockdolager, music in her steps, would surely have been recorded by them as a goddess of the hunt, spoken of in books of legend."
— One of Sockdolager's designers

Svarog Heavy Industries undertook the forest protection program mainly in order to improve their brand image, but they spoke very little of a "hunting support Doll". As for the reason why, the undertaking of hunting was not widely accepted for common people yet. Scientific studies had already proven that correctly designated hunting could be helpful in allowing ecosystem growth and protecting biodiversity, but in the eyes of many, hunters were still equivalent to "destroyers of the environment".

As a Doll, Sockdolager was the center of even more contention than human hunters. Some very agitated civilian activists, after coming to know of her existence, even took their objections to the researchers' doorsteps, demanding for Sockdolager to be decommissioned.

Sockdolager has never responded to the points of controversy around herself. According to those in contact with her, she would always be happily babbling away about something related to plants whenever she returned to the research facility, as if there was nothing in the world more worthy of her attention except that patch of nature she had dedicated herself to.

"If one day I can't be a hunter anymore... put me on a farm, then. Sounds nice, eh?"

In an incident on a cooperative hunting mission, a client, despite Sockdolager's cautioning, ventured past a warning line and into a dangerous area. They were assaulted by dangerous animals, and Sockdolager was forced to kill numerous I-Level Endangered Animals.

After this incident went public, animal protection groups and Doll research organizations began a lengthy debate on whether the action of Dolls would also fall under Force Majeure. Svarog Heavy Industries produced a large variety of documents, proving that Sockdolager poses no threat to wild animals in their natural environment, and many clients made themselves known to defend her. Nevertheless, under tremendous pressure, Sockdolager's work was forcibly put to an end.

Svarog considered lending out Sockdolager for other purposes, but despite her excellent stealth capabilities and mechanical precision in the usage of weapons, her gentle temperament made her unfitting for military work, and when it came to the farmhand work that she pined for, she had no talent to speak of.

After failures in multiple fields, Svarog Heavy Industries sent Sockdolager off to Project Neural Cloud. At the very least, over there, her unique talents and dispositions would be preserved.

Sockdolager was troubled in trying to adjust to her new environment at first—there was no nature to find comfort in, and no lovable critters to be found. Records indicate that she "was alert as if she was in the wilderness, even if she was in her dorm."

Unexpectedly for the Medical Department, what brought change to the situation was Angela's storytelling. At first, Sockdolager, like a bird concealing itself behind the leaves of a tree, hid herself by the door, listening in in secret. She was soon found by Angela, almost in a trance, and invited to sit together with everyone else. Afterwards, whenever Angela opened her great book of stories, Sockdolager could be found by the fireplace, drawn on her face a pleasant orange glow. According to Sockdolager herself, it made her reminisce of her times back in the woodland cabin, when everyone would gather around the fireplace, and tell their stories.

Sockdolager returned to her merry self soon enough, and fit in well enough with everyone in the Oasis. However, Hobbie's presence often discomforted Sako, and there was an inevitable awkwardness whenever Sockdolager encountered Simo in her daily duties.
oathDesc: Wreathed in the fragrance of fields and forests.

projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Shhh — The forest is speaking, can you hear it?"

projections.name: Running Through The Woods
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Over the hills, across the streams and in the shadow of the trees, I am one with the forest."

skinList.name: Boreal Vigil
skinList.desc:
Mythical Journey—Within a mysterious domain, the Dolls lose themselves in ancient myths, searching for the lingering echoes of legendary heroes.
Within the freezing, withered Járnviðr, the sentinel who commands giant wolves and hunting eagles stalks the woods and defends the ways of the northern frontier.
"A harsh winter is upon us. I will follow the guidance of the runes and hunt down all interlopers, until the day I can no longer stand."

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
We shall be written into a landscape of 0s and 1s, a deviation in system workings, a ripple in neural cycles, a piece of memory that shall never be wiped away.
""Can this arrow stuffed with fervent feelings hit the Professor's heart? I can't wait to find out!""
